page.layout: One printed page. Running title and page number at the top. Below them a centred title block: "EMBLEMA", then "ERVNT HOMINES", then the Greek line "ΑΣΠΟΝΤΟΙ." An engraving fills the middle of the page. Below it, four lines of italic verse, set in staggered indents. At the lower right, the word "Nulla" as catchword.

main_text.head: EMBLEMA ERVNT HOMINES ΑΣΠΟΝΤΟΙ.
main_text.p: [Engraving: a street scene with houses, a church spire and a fountain-like building at the back. In the foreground a man in a cloak draws a sword against a second swordsman. A skeleton with a spear stands behind them, and a dog runs at the lower left. Figures fight in the background, and a group of townspeople stands at the right.]

l.i: Tum Fortuna suas roraret diuite cornu

page.notes: The engraving is described only in brief; no printed text is inside it. The page number "132" at top left is partly worn and may be read differently; it is marked [?]. The catchword "Nulla" is set at the lower right, after the verse. The Greek word ΑΣΠΟΝΤΟΙ is copied as printed.
